method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (4 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 4 Nov 2026: OECD Inclusive Framework plenary announcement (30 Oct) and October 2026 outcome statement PDF fetched and read. Prior catalogued items unchanged (GIR XML Schema v2.0 ~20 Oct; Romania STTR deposit 2 Oct). No further OECD Pillar Two model-rules, GIR, STTR or Central Record release found for 3–4 Nov 2026.
coverage.HK: Checked 4 Nov 2026: IRD What's New fetched.
